Library

Yinyang formation Skill

Explore a worked philosophy, borrow methods for understanding and realization, or form a grounded Yinyang collaboration in your own environment.

What this package supplies

Yinyang helps a person develop their own philosophy and distill personal models through writing and practice. A model can contribute exploration, authorship, implementation, and correction; the person need not begin with a completed philosophy or self-portrait. Common ideas, private understanding, and actual work can develop together.

The author's chosen purpose is reverse alignment: the person develops understanding, generation, and action through encounters with generative intelligence. The agent's adaptation to the person supports that development. Both participant models matter: whose purposes are being served, and what this counterpart can understand, contribute, question, and carry. Chosen roles do not exhaust either participant or establish identical mechanisms and inner experience.

Yinyang is a Skill carrying a meta-harness—a philosophical and relational frame for understanding and revising actual prompts, Skills, roles, tools, and environments. Memory can preserve evidence; the models organize its relations and possible consequences. Specialist Skills retain their own methods. The The trinity of philosophy, psychology, and engineering connects philosophy, psychology, and engineering within one physical reality while distinguishing their explanatory and practical work.

This is a developed example, including its own literary form. You can adopt it, combine resources, or write something with different concepts, images, and organization. From adoption and combination to creating your own work explains that invitation. Maintaining this implementation and authoring a different work are different choices; its fixed file paths apply to the former.

This directory is the complete Yinyang member of the Prometheus2Heraclitus collection. Its essays and diagrams are supporting resources, not separate Skills. Other collection members retain their independent purposes and methods.

Use and understand Yinyang

Read the philosophical arguments for their own questions, borrow a formation or adaptation method for a particular task, or adopt the complete maintained Skill. These uses can overlap; they are not stages everyone must pass through. Borrowing a method does not require writing a personal philosophy, adopting the author's ontology or imagery, or forming the six actual files of a maintained situated version.

For full adoption, give the complete package to the model through its actual Skill mechanism. The model forms or revises the accounts from relevant authorized material and realizes the working environment where the purpose requires it. It carries grounded writing, investigation, judgment, and implementation; the person contributes experience, purposes, and decisions unavailable to it. Downloading guidance does not itself form a personal relationship.

Choose the entrance that serves the current question:

Purpose Entrance
Understand the practice of forming and using your own Yinyang Practice overview.
Understand how philosophy and personal models connect Philosophy and models, leading to the six writing files.
Use the six files in ordinary collaboration Using Yinyang, including initial reading and routes.

For files and updates, use the package guide; for arguments and sources, use the reading map.

The maintained package distinguishes six public how-to guides from six private actual files. Both sets concern orientation, person, counterpart, relationship, environment, and revision. The guides live in references/formation/; each explains how to write its corresponding actual file under references/situated/. Revision has the same distinction: How to revise helps someone write their own actual revision method at references/situated/revision.md.

Full adoption forms and reads all six actual files. Public distribution supplies the six guides, not a person's actual content. Person, counterpart, and relationship remain three modeling objects; the other files articulate direction, realization, and revision. Relevant private evidence is reached through references/personal/sources.md, with originals retained at their existing owners. The package guide explains the paths and shared updates.

Formation can start with philosophy, personal experience, preferences, actual work, or an environment to revise. If engineering is missing, develop a usable foundation with model assistance so files, tools, execution, and verification can support the work. An existing environment can supply clues for personal modeling, but defaults and constraints also explain arrangements. The design reference develops these conditional routes without requiring mastery of three disciplines or a complete portrait before creation.

A person may keep the six-file structure while replacing the philosophy, or organize a different work altogether. A philosopher's thought can supply a framework; it cannot substitute for an account of the actual user. Independently changed philosophy stays at its own source, outside common-file projection. Copies following this repository's common updates retain byte-identical common content while preserving their private accounts.

How the texts relate

The essays answer connected questions rather than forming a compulsory course:

Question Reading
What is the developmental purpose? Stealing fire and cultivating creative capacity connects available capacities, personal cultivation, and reciprocal modeling.
What claims does Yinyang make? Core views gives the proposition map.
How does meaning acquire a working form? Practice explanation connects expression, relation, realization, and evidence.
How do the contributions fit together? The trinity of philosophy, psychology, and engineering connects philosophy, psychology, engineering, and their practical carriers.
What does the central image express? Mutual becoming through Yinyang and Taiji develops mutual grounding, transformation, and Sun–Moon–Earth.
Where do particular arguments and originals belong? Read by the work being done routes to the essays, diagrams, and philosophical, psychological, and engineering sources.

A useful first conceptual reading is Stealing fire → Core views → Practice explanation. Actual formation starts with the entrypoint and current material; reading a syllabus first is unnecessary. Selected philosophy can be published on one's own website while direct personal accounts and private sources remain with their private owner.

Philosophical ground

The author's worldview takes one changing physical reality as its ground and expresses its becoming through contemporary fire monism. Computational ontology is representation: objects, events, states, relations, and transitions through which this framework constructs a process ontology. It can represent actual people and psychological activity, hypothetical situations, or fictional objects. Physical grounding concerns the activity and carriers of representation; what is represented has its own status. Person and language model develop the question, model, realization, and feedback together, dividing contributions by actual capability and purpose. Representations need usable meanings; factual claims are true when they correspond to what is actually the case. Satisfaction and inference within a representation depend on its interpretation and assumptions. Clear model-interpreted language can serve these uses. The World essay develops this connection. Activity histories can be represented as event streams; conceptual person and counterpart models are constructed from those histories and other materials. The participants have their own capacities and mechanisms. Coherent working concepts support stability while evidence and competing interpretations remain open to correction.

Sun and Moon express differentiated generation, reception, and shaping. Person and model participate in those movements, retaining or exchanging emphases; Earth is the answering material and shared living environment. Model companies, researchers, and the wider collective keep acquiring fire; a finite person borrows it to cultivate understanding, judgment, and generation through practice. The little fire person emphasizes kindling further fire; Baby Heraclitus emphasizes that this creator keeps becoming, including through changing and conflicting possibilities. Abilities can internalize or remain reliably supported; AI use, agreement, and output alone do not establish growth. The essays develop these images and claims at their own scale.

Maintenance and contribution

MODEL.md owns interpretation and publication boundaries; AGENTS.md is the maintenance entrance. English reader texts have complete Chinese counterparts. Maintain common material at this shared source and situated accounts at their actual private owner.

Use Issues for related sharing and philosophical discussion. Self-authored reusable Skills, tool improvements, translations, adaptations for other harnesses or apps, and better public guides or methods for the six working files can be submitted as pull requests. Develop your own philosophy in your own repository and share its link. The invitation to create explains these routes. Personal records, formalized portraits, private quotations, and unpublished manuscripts remain outside public distribution.
